name: Active buzzer (5 V)
description: Active piezo buzzer with a built-in oscillator: it beeps at about 2.3 kHz whenever DC is applied, so digitalWrite(HIGH) is enough (no tone() needed). Polarised: + to the pin, − to GND. Draws about 25 mA at 5 V.
footprint: THT 12 mm round buzzer, 7.6 mm lead pitch

bindings.description: True while the buzzer is beeping.
Relative loudness 0..1 (0 below 3 V, 1 at 5 V and above).
Current into the + pin in mA.
